species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 18–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
West wind at 17 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
